name: @corbits-builder/server-publish
description: Your own server: one you already rent. Your hosting provider bills you.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project has an app and the person wants it published on a server of their own that they rent, so people can open it.
builder.unless: The project has no app yet, or the person wants it published somewhere else.

steps.title: Check your app is ready for your server
Publish the app to your server

input.instruction: Publish the project's saved app to the person's own server, readying the server first if it needs it, and report the address people open it at.

steps.title: Confirm the saved version is the one published

builder.firstPublish: It goes on your own server, at its IP address. That address isn't secure (https) yet, so don't use the app for passwords or payments.
examples: publish my app on my own server
put the app on the VPS I rent
